Are you someone who loves to roll up your sleeves and work in a dynamic — yet chilly — environment? As a Logistics Employee at a food production company in Boxtel, you’ll help keep the logistics process running smoothly. Together with a team of enthusiastic colleagues, you’ll make sure products are delivered to the right place at the right time.

A day in the life of a Logistics Employee:

You’ll start your day with a short team briefing, where you’ll hear what’s on the schedule. Then it’s time to get to work — receiving and checking incoming goods, ensuring everything is stored in the correct location. Throughout the day, you’ll help prepare orders and make sure everything is properly packaged. Before heading home, you’ll check with your colleagues to confirm everything is ready for the next day.No two days are the same — that’s what makes this job both challenging and fun!

If you can see yourself in this role, don’t miss out — apply now!

- A valid reach truck and EPT certificate (or relevant experience with the ability to obtain them soon)
- Experience in logistics or food production, or willingness to learn
- A proactive and accurate work attitude
- Good command of Dutch and English
- Physically capable of working in a logistics environment
- Willingness to work in cold and freezer areas (you’ll receive an extra allowance for this)
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Flexibility with working hours in two shifts: 07:00-15:00 & 15:00-00:00
